Chapter 1040: 5 Chaos (Requesting Monthly Votes)

Chapter 1040: Chapter 5 Chaos (Requesting Monthly Votes)

The moment the Fierce Sun Divine Body was formed, a torrent of instinctual information surged into Lin Yuan’s mind.

Lin Yuan’s consciousness rapidly absorbed the information. These bits of knowledge stemmed from the divine body’s inherent instincts, much like how a person instinctively knows how to breathe or open their eyes upon birth.

“This is the Fierce Sun Divine Body?” Lin Yuan couldn’t help but feel a sense of awe in his heart. During the metamorphosis of the divine body earlier, he had already sensed the intimidating nature of this constitution.

In addition to the many texts and legacies within the Sky Burning Court, there were detailed descriptions of the Fierce Sun Divine Body.

It was only when his physical body had completely transformed into the Fierce Sun Divine Body that Lin Yuan realized he had underestimated it.

“Too powerful.” Lin Yuan raised his right hand. Although it remained flesh and blood, the smallest microcosmic components had already transformed into countless Fierce Sun particles, marked with deep and mysterious patterns on their surface.

“Burn everything, devour everything?” Lin Yuan carefully felt every intricate detail of the Fierce Sun Divine Body.

When Lin Yuan condensed the thirty thousandth Seed of the Fierce Sun, his spirit and will had once entered a crimson space, where he glimpsed what seemed to be the figure of the Ancestor of Fierce Sun.

It had countless manifestations; different beings perceived it in different forms.

Similarly, the Fierce Sun Divine Body… varies among awakened individuals, with each being distinct.

Lin Yuan’s Fierce Sun Divine Body, while maintaining the infinite power of burning, was also endowed with a devouring force.

Anything—living or dead—burned to ashes by the divine body’s power could have its Origin Source directly absorbed.

Even space and time could be set ablaze, converting into Origin Source to replenish Lin Yuan.

This devouring and absorption process happens instantaneously; it requires no refining time whatsoever.

Simply put, for Lin Yuan at this moment, battles were not an expenditure—they were feasts.

“This ability…” Lin Yuan shook his head slightly. It was truly monstrous, tantamount to a ‘Perpetual Motion Machine,’ eliminating any concerns of depletion.

Consider this: even Chaos Venerables worry about resource exhaustion. Chaos Great Saints manage somewhat better by constantly refining Chaos Qi to sustain themselves.

But what if there was no Chaos Qi around?

Lin Yuan’s Fierce Sun Divine Body possessed the ability to burn and devour everything—Chaos Qi, enemy killing blows, visible and invisible elements, tangible and intangible—all could be burned and devoured.

*Huala la.*

At his fingertips, Lin Yuan ignited a tiny flame.

The flame burned silently, warping the surrounding space slightly. Cracks began to appear, and Lin Yuan immediately felt streams of warmth flowing into his physical body.

“So this is the sensation of burning and devouring space?”

Lin Yuan’s expression was thoughtful, and he promptly extinguished the flame.

This ability must still be used cautiously; a single misstep could cause massive collapses in time and space, potentially drawing the attention of the upper echelons of the Fierce Sun Ancient Country.

After all, allowing Lin Yuan to recklessly burn everything might incinerate the entire Fierce Sun Ancient Country.

Of course, the territory of the Ancient Country was vast and boundless. Burning and devouring such a massive area would likely take an unimaginable amount of time.

Furthermore, the Dukes and Kings within the country would never stand idly by, let alone the Eternal Sun that reigns supreme above the heavens.

The key point was that the Origin Source gained through devouring could replenish consumption, heal injuries, but offered little else in utility.

“My current strength…” Lin Yuan let out a long breath.

The so-called burning and devouring were merely one of the abilities appended to the Fierce Sun Divine Body. After completing its metamorphosis, Lin Yuan’s physical strength and vitality had skyrocketed immensely.

“In direct combat, I shouldn’t be weaker than the true forms of beings birthed from the Chaos Void. If it comes to a prolonged stalemate, I’d ultimately be the one to prevail.”

Lin Yuan examined himself. The burning and devouring ability of his awakened Fierce Sun Divine Body rendered him unmatched in endurance-based battles.

Trying to outlast him?

Even Great Saints might not surpass Lin Yuan.

“Transform into the Fierce Sun! Transform into the Fierce Sun!” Lin Yuan sensed the intricacies of the divine body. Every strong individual who awakens the Fierce Sun Divine Body shares one unifying ability.

That is—the transformation into the Fierce Sun.

This serves as the ultimate finishing move of the Fierce Sun Divine Body. Once activated, the physical body and essential vitality are completely converted into a miniature Fierce Sun.

At that point, one can draw a tiny, insignificant trace of power from the Eternal Sun that resides above the heavens.

Of course, using this ultimate move places an immense burden on the Origin Source of the Fierce Sun Divine Body. Unless it’s absolutely necessary, it’s best avoided.

Once activated, recovering from it could take millions, if not tens of millions, of years.

“My awakened Fierce Sun Divine Body offers far greater physical and vital enhancements compared to other similar bodies.”

Lin Yuan thought to himself. The Fierce Sun Divine Body was known as the strongest divine body within the Fierce Sun Ancient Country, with ample documentation describing its properties.

Lin Yuan was also aware of the enhancements experienced by others who awakened the Fierce Sun Divine Body.

However, the degree of improvement fell far below his own.

“It’s the influence of the Seeds of the Fierce Sun.” Lin Yuan nodded slightly.

As early as during the metamorphosis of the Fierce Sun Divine Body, Lin Yuan had noticed the quantity of Seeds had a profound effect on the transformation of his body.

Now this conclusion had been confirmed.

In reality, the more Seeds of the Fierce Sun one condenses, the stronger the awakened divine body becomes. Among the Great Lords of the Fierce Sun Ancient Country, this was not considered a secret.

But knowing is one thing—being able to achieve it is another entirely.

…

Chaos Void.

Lin Yuan sat cross-legged.

“Fierce Sun Divine Body…”

Lin Yuan carefully observed every detail of the Fierce Sun Divine Body.

His Origin World avatar shared the same consciousness as him, meaning Lin Yuan could examine the divine body from every conceivable angle.
